options.text: A family of services for ingesting and processing high-throughput, real-time streaming data at scale.
An open-source framework for stateful, real-time stream processing of unbounded, continuous data with low latency.
An open-source distributed data-processing engine that processes large datasets in parallel using in-memory computation.
A serverless compute service that runs code in response to events without provisioning any servers.

questions.text: A high-throughput stream of clickstream events needs to be ingested and consumed simultaneously by several independent applications — a real-time dashboard, an ML feature pipeline, and long-term storage — using custom producers and consumers you build yourself. Which service fits?
questions.explanation: Kinesis Data Streams is a raw, low-latency stream that multiple producers can write to and multiple independent consumers can read from concurrently, unlike Firehose's managed, no-code delivery model.
